# TrackMyRMC

> Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) Supply Chain Management & Transit Mixer Telematics Platform

TrackMyRMC is a software platform designed to help Ready Mix Concrete businesses manage plant operations, transit mixer tracking, dispatch, delivery and digital documentation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Transit Mixer Tracking**: Vehicle GPS and telematics to monitor truck location, transit routes, road speed, drum rotation status, and estimated time of arrival.
- **Plant Operations**: Silo inventory monitoring and automated batch dispatch integration.
- **Digital Documentation**: Digital delivery challans and electronic Proof of Delivery (POD) capturing slump test results, batch specifications, site arrival timestamps, and digital customer signatures.
- **Pour Planning**: Concrete volume estimation for structural elements (slabs, columns, beams, footings).

## Primary Users
- RMC Plant Owners & Operations Directors
- Batching Supervisors & Plant Operators
- Fleet Dispatchers & Logistics Managers
- Transit Mixer Drivers / Pilots
- Construction Contractors & Site Engineers
